subject: Operations
title: The Gig Economy in Operations
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Gig Economy in Operations.

hook.text: A warehouse needs 200 extra workers for Black Friday. They hire gig workers through an app. By Monday, they're gone.

buildup.text: The gig economy provides on-demand labor—flexible workers who join for specific tasks or peak periods.

discovery.text: It gives operations elastic capacity: scale up for demand spikes and scale down without carrying fixed labor costs.

twist.text: Gig workers lack training and loyalty. Quality and safety can suffer when the workforce changes every week.

climax.text: Platforms like Instawork and Veryable match operations with vetted gig workers—staffing meets the app economy.

punchline.text: Flexible labor solves peaks. Training solves quality.

quiz.question: What is a risk of using gig workers in operations?
options: They may lack training and consistency
